<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Vegan Ramen</title>
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }
  html, body {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background-color: #080605;
    touch-action: none;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    cursor: grab;
  }
  body:active {
    cursor: grabbing;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="scene"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');

  // Reduced motion preference
  const motionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  let reducedMotion = motionQuery.matches;

  // WebGL2 initialization with graceful fallback
  const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl2', {
    alpha: false,
    antialias: false,
    depth: false,
    stencil: false,
    powerPreference: 'high-performance',
    preserveDrawingBuffer: false
  });

  if (!gl) {
    renderCanvas2DFallback(canvas, reducedMotion);
    return;
  }

  const extFloat = gl.getExtension('EXT_color_buffer_float');
  gl.getExtension('OES_texture_float_linear');

  // Vertex shader (full-screen triangle)
  const VERT_SRC = `#version 300 es
  precision highp float;
  out vec2 vUv;
  void main() {
    vec2 p = vec2((gl_VertexID << 1) & 2, gl_VertexID & 2);
    vUv = p;
    gl_Position = vec4(p * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
  }`;

  // Pass 1: 3D Raymarched Vegan Ramen + Broth Refraction + Volumetric Steam
  const SCENE_FRAG_SRC = `#version 300 es
  precision highp float;

  in vec2 vUv;
  out vec4 fragColor;

  uniform vec2 uRes;
  uniform float uTime;
  uniform vec2 uMouse;       // Smoothed normalized pointer [-1, 1]
  uniform vec2 uMouseVel;    // Pointer velocity for steam/broth stir
  uniform vec3 uMouseWorld;  // Intersection of pointer ray with broth plane (x, z, active)
  uniform vec4 uRipple;      // (x, z, startTime, strength)
  uniform float uReduced;

  #define PI 3.14159265359
  #define TAU 6.28318530718

  // Material IDs
  #define MAT_TABLE     1.0
  #define MAT_BOWL      2.0
  #define MAT_NORI      3.0
  #define MAT_NOODLE    4.0
  #define MAT_MUSHROOM  5.0
  #define MAT_SHIITAKE  6.0
  #define MAT_BOKCHOY   7.0
  #define MAT_TOFU      8.0
  #define MAT_CORN      9.0
  #define MAT_SCALLION 10.0
  #define MAT_CHILI    11.0

  // --- Hash & Noise Utilities ---
  float hash12(vec2 p) {
    vec3 p3 = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * 0.1031);
    p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);
    return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);
  }

  vec2 hash22(vec2 p) {
    vec3 p3 = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * vec3(0.1031, 0.1030, 0.0973));
    p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);
    return fract((p3.xx + p3.yz) * p3.zy);
  }

  float hash13(vec3 p3) {
    p3 = fract(p3 * 0.1031);
    p3 += dot(p3, p3.zyx + 31.32);
    return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);
  }

  float noise2(vec2 p) {
    vec2 i = floor(p);
    vec2 f = fract(p);
    f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
    float a = hash12(i);
    float b = hash12(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0));
    float c = hash12(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0));
    float d = hash12(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0));
    return mix(mix(a, b, f.x), mix(c, d, f.x), f.y);
  }

  float noise3(vec3 p) {
    vec3 i = floor(p);
    vec3 f = fract(p);
    f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
    float n000 = hash13(i);
    float n100 = hash13(i + vec3(1,0,0));
    float n010 = hash13(i + vec3(0,1,0));
    float n110 = hash13(i + vec3(1,1,0));
    float n001 = hash13(i + vec3(0,0,1));
    float n101 = hash13(i + vec3(1,0,1));
    float n011 = hash13(i + vec3(0,1,1));
    float n111 = hash13(i + vec3(1,1,1));
    return mix(
      mix(mix(n000, n100, f.x), mix(n010, n110, f.x), f.y),
      mix(mix(n001, n101, f.x), mix(n011, n111, f.x), f.y),
      f.z
    );
  }

  float fbm2(vec2 p) {
    float v = 0.0, a = 0.5;
    mat2 m = mat2(0.8, 0.6, -0.6, 0.8);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      v += a * noise2(p);
      p = m * p * 2.03 + 11.7;
      a *= 0.5;
    }
    return v;
  }

  float fbm3(vec3 p) {
    float v = 0.0, a = 0.5;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      v += a * noise3(p);
      p = p * 2.02 + vec3(13.1, 7.7, 5.3);
      a *= 0.5;
    }
    return v;
  }

  mat2 rot2(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat2(c, -s, s, c);
  }

  // --- SDF Primitives ---
  float smin(float a, float b, float k) {
    float h = max(k - abs(a - b), 0.0) / k;
    return min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
  }

  float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 b) {
    vec3 q = abs(p) - b;
    return length(max(q, 0.0)) + min(max(q.x, max(q.y, q.z)), 0.0);
  }

  float sdBox2D(vec2 p, vec2 b) {
    vec2 d = abs(p) - b;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
  }

  float sdCappedCylinder(vec3 p, float r, float h) {
    vec2 d = abs(vec2(length(p.xz), p.y)) - vec2(r, h);
    return min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0) + length(max(d, 0.0));
  }

  float sdTorus(vec3 p, vec2 t) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz) - t.x, p.y);
    return length(q) - t.y;
  }

  float sdCapsule(vec3 p, vec3 a, vec3 b, float r) {
    vec3 pa = p - a, ba = b - a;
    float h = clamp(dot(pa, ba) / dot(ba, ba), 0.0, 1.0);
    return length(pa - ba * h) - r;
  }

  // Exact 2D Quadratic Bezier distance (Inigo Quilez)
  vec2 sdBezier2D(vec2 pos, vec2 A, vec2 B, vec2 C) {
    vec2 a = B - A;
    vec2 b = A - 2.0 * B + C;
    vec2 c = a * 2.0;
    vec2 d = A - pos;
    float kk = 1.0 / dot(b, b);
    float kx = kk * dot(a, b);
    float ky = kk * (2.0 * dot(a, a) + dot(d, b)) / 3.0;
    float kz = kk * dot(d, a);
    float p = ky - kx * kx;
    float p3 = p * p * p;
    float q = kx * (2.0 * kx * kx - 3.0 * ky) + kz;
    float h = q * q + 4.0 * p3;
    float res;
    float tOut;
    if (h >= 0.0) {
      h = sqrt(h);
      vec2 x = (vec2(h, -h) - q) / 2.0;
      vec2 uv = sign(x) * pow(abs(x), vec2(1.0 / 3.0));
      float t = clamp(uv.x + uv.y - kx, 0.0, 1.0);
      vec2 qv = d + (c + b * t) * t;
      res = dot(qv, qv);
      tOut = t;
    } else {
      float z = sqrt(-p);
      float v = acos(clamp(q / (p * z * 2.0), -1.0, 1.0)) / 3.0;
      float m = cos(v);
      float n = sin(v) * 1.732050808;
      vec3 t = clamp(vec3(m + m, -n - m, n - m) * z - kx, 0.0, 1.0);
      vec2 qx = d + (c + b * t.x) * t.x; float dx = dot(qx, qx);
      vec2 qy = d + (c + b * t.y) * t.y; float dy = dot(qy, qy);
      if (dx < dy) { res = dx; tOut = t.x; } else { res = dy; tOut = t.y; }
    }
    return vec2(sqrt(res), tOut);
  }

  vec2 opU(vec2 a, vec2 b) {
    return (a.x < b.x) ? a : b;
  }

  // --- Hand-Thrown Ceramic Bowl ---
  float sdBowl(vec3 p) {
    float r = length(p.xz);
    float ang = atan(p.z, p.x);
    float asym = 0.007 * sin(3.0 * ang + 0.5) + 0.004 * cos(5.0 * ang - 0.8);
    float rimWave = 0.008 * sin(2.0 * ang + 1.1) + 0.004 * sin(4.0 * ang);

    vec2 q = vec2(r, p.y);

    // Flat inner bottom segment
    float dBottom = length(vec2(max(q.x - 0.36, 0.0), q.y + 0.49)) - 0.044;

    // Curved potter wall
    vec2 bz = sdBezier2D(q, vec2(0.36, -0.49), vec2(0.97, -0.46), vec2(1.045 + asym, 0.435 + rimWave));
    float wallThick = mix(0.044, 0.031, bz.y) + 0.006 * smoothstep(0.88, 1.0, bz.y);
    float dWall = bz.x - wallThick;

    float dVessel = min(dBottom, dWall);

    // Foot ring (koudai) resting on y = -0.62
    float dFoot = sdBox2D(q - vec2(0.43, -0.555), vec2(0.028, 0.055)) - 0.010;
    return smin(dVessel, dFoot, 0.022);
  }

  // --- Broth Height & Chili Oil Pattern ---
  // Returns: x = broth height, y = chili oil mask [0..1], z = black garlic swirl [0..1]
  vec3 evalBrothState(vec2 xz) {
    float r = length(xz);
    float t = uTime;

    // Subtle meniscus climb at bowl wall & gentle convection ripples
    float meniscus = 0.012 * smoothstep(0.84, 0.965, r);
    float wave = 0.0022 * sin(xz.x * 14.0 + t * 1.5) * cos(xz.y * 12.0 - t * 1.2)
               + 0.0014 * sin(r * 22.0 - t * 2.1);

    // Interactive mouse hover ripple / wake
    if (uMouseWorld.z > 0.5) {
      float dm = length(xz - uMouseWorld.xy);
      float stir = exp(-dm * dm * 18.0) * min(length(uMouseVel) * 1.6, 0.8);
      wave += 0.005 * sin(dm * 34.0 - t * 6.5) * exp(-dm * 4.5) * (0.25 + stir);
    }

    // Click ripple impulse
    float dtRipple = t - uRipple.z;
    if (dtRipple > 0.0 && dtRipple < 4.5 && uRipple.w > 0.0) {
      float dr = length(xz - uRipple.xy);
      float front = dr - dtRipple * 0.48;
      float env = exp(-abs(front) * 14.0) * exp(-dtRipple * 1.15) * uRipple.w;
      wave += 0.009 * sin(front * 42.0) * env;
    }

    // Floating Rayu (chili oil) droplets: multi-scale organic metaball cells
    vec2 drift = xz + vec2(sin(t * 0.14), cos(t * 0.11)) * 0.035;
    if (uMouseWorld.z > 0.5) {
      vec2 away = xz - uMouseWorld.xy;
      float d2 = dot(away, away) + 0.04;
      drift -= away * (0.018 / d2) * min(length(uMouseVel) + 0.25, 1.0);
    }

    // Cluster chili oil in natural zones (front-left, front-right, rim arcs)
    float oilField = 0.0;
    // Medium & small Voronoi droplets
    for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
      float sc = (k == 0) ? 7.5 : 15.0;
      vec2 st = drift * sc + float(k) * 17.3;
      vec2 ip = floor(st);
      vec2 fp = fract(st);
      for (int j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {
        for (int i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
          vec2 g = vec2(float(i), float(j));
          vec2 rnd = hash22(ip + g);
          // Only spawn oil in ~48% of cells
          if (rnd.x > 0.50) {
            vec2 o = 0.5 + 0.36 * sin(rnd * TAU + t * 0.35);
            float rad = (k == 0 ? 0.28 : 0.22) * (0.55 + 0.65 * fract(rnd.y * 7.13));
            float dist = length(g + o - fp);
            oilField += smoothstep(rad, rad * 0.42, dist);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    // Zone modulation so broth shows both creamy golden areas and ruby oil pools
    float zone = smoothstep(-0.15, 0.45, sin(xz.x * 3.8 + 0.9) * cos(xz.y * 3.2 - 0.4) + 0.25 * smoothstep(0.55, 0.90, r));
    float oilMask = clamp(smoothstep(0.32, 0.72, oilField * (0.45 + 0.75 * zone)), 0.0, 1.0);

    // Oil surface-tension dome raises height subtly by ~1.8mm
    float oilDome = 0.0022 * smoothstep(0.0, 0.65, oilMask);

    // Subtle roasted black garlic oil (mayu) aromatic swirl ribbons
    vec2 mw = drift * 3.4 + 0.35 * vec2(fbm2(drift * 5.0), fbm2(drift * 5.0 + 9.2));
    float mayu = smoothstep(0.76, 0.90, sin(mw.x * 4.5 + mw.y * 3.0)) * smoothstep(0.85, 0.35, r) * (1.0 - oilMask * 0.7);

    float h = 0.220 + meniscus + wave + oilDome;
    return vec3(h, oilMask, mayu);
  }

  // --- Wavy Alkaline Ramen Noodles ---
  float sdNoodles(vec3 p) {
    float r2 = dot(p.xz, p.xz);
    if (r2 > 0.88 || p.y > 0.33 || p.y < 0.07) {
      return max(p.y - 0.31, sqrt(max(r2, 0.0001)) - 0.92);
    }

    // Folded men-age arch higher in front-center/center-left, deeper at edges
    float mound = 0.205
      + 0.044 * exp(-dot(p.xz - vec2(-0.02, 0.20), p.xz - vec2(-0.02, 0.20)) * 6.5)
      - 0.055 * smoothstep(0.55, 0.92, sqrt(r2));

    // Layer 1: Sweeping curved noodle bundle
    vec2 q1 = rot2(-0.38) * p.xz;
    q1.y += 0.32 * q1.x * q1.x; // Natural chopstick-fold bend
    float sp1 = 0.045;
    float w1 = 0.021 * sin(q1.x * 27.0 + sin(q1.y * 11.0)) + 0.009 * cos(q1.x * 47.0);
    float idx1 = floor((q1.y + w1) / sp1);
    float u1 = (fract((q1.y + w1) / sp1) - 0.5) * sp1;
    float h1 = mound + 0.017 * sin(q1.x * 12.0 + idx1 * 2.3) + 0.007 * cos(idx1 * 4.1);
    float d1 = length(vec2(u1, p.y - h1)) - 0.0195;

    // Layer 2: Interwoven cross-under wave bundle
    vec2 q2 = rot2(0.72) * p.xz;
    q2.y -= 0.25 * q2.x * q2.x;
    float sp2 = 0.047;
    float w2 = 0.020 * sin(q2.x * 25.0 - 1.2) + 0.008 * sin(q2.x * 43.0);
    float idx2 = floor((q2.y + w2) / sp2);
    float u2 = (fract((q2.y + w2) / sp2) - 0.5) * sp2;
    float h2 = mound - 0.016 + 0.018 * cos(q2.x * 10.5 + idx2 * 1.9);
    float d2 = length(vec2(u2, p.y - h2)) - 0.0195;

    float d = smin(d1, d2, 0.008);
    // Clip cleanly inside inner bowl radius
    return max(d, sqrt(r2) - 0.90);
  }

  // --- Single King Oyster Mushroom Medallion ---
  float sdEringiOne(vec3 p, vec3 c, vec2 tilt, float rad, float hh) {
    vec3 q = p - c;
    q.xy = rot2(tilt.x) * q.xy;
    q.zy = rot2(tilt.y) * q.zy;
    float ang = atan(q.z, q.x);
    float rMod = rad + 0.007 * sin(3.0 * ang + c.x * 9.0) + 0.004 * cos(5.0 * ang);
    float d = sdCappedCylinder(q, rMod - 0.016, hh - 0.016) - 0.016;
    // Score cuts on top face
    if (d < 0.025 && q.y > 0.0) {
      vec2 sc = rot2(0.65) * q.xz * 22.0;
      float g1 = smoothstep(0.11, 0.0, abs(fract(sc.x) - 0.5));
      float g2 = smoothstep(0.11, 0.0, abs(fract(sc.y) - 0.5));
      float groove = max(g1, g2) * smoothstep(0.01, hh, q.y) * smoothstep(rMod, rMod - 0.025, length(q.xz));
      d += groove * 0.0055;
    }
    return d;
  }

  // --- Scene Solid SDF ---
  vec2 mapSolid(vec3 p) {
    // Ground plane: Dark yakisugi/walnut table at y = -0.62
    vec2 res = vec2(p.y + 0.62, MAT_TABLE);

    // Outer bounding cylinder around bowl + nori
    float rXZ = length(p.xz);
    if (rXZ > 1.18 || p.y > 0.92) {
      return res;
    }

    // Handcrafted ceramic bowl
    float dBowl = sdBowl(p);
    res = opU(res, vec2(dBowl, MAT_BOWL));

    // Two crisp Nori sheets tucked at back-right rim
    if (p.x > 0.10 && p.z < 0.05 && p.y > 0.14) {
      // Sheet 1 (left-back of pair)
      vec3 n1 = p - vec3(0.45, 0.45, -0.58);
      n1.xz = rot2(-0.58) * n1.xz;
      n1.zy = rot2(-0.42) * n1.zy;
      n1.z -= 0.10 * n1.x * n1.x + 0.008 * sin(n1.y * 10.0);
      float dn1 = sdBox(n1, vec3(0.205, 0.30, 0.005)) - 0.005;

      // Sheet 2 (overlapping right-back)
      vec3 n2 = p - vec3(0.66, 0.42, -0.37);
      n2.xz = rot2(-0.96) * n2.xz;
      n2.zy = rot2(-0.46) * n2.zy;
      n2.z -= 0.10 * n2.x * n2.x + 0.008 * cos(n2.y * 11.0);
      float dn2 = sdBox(n2, vec3(0.195, 0.285, 0.005)) - 0.005;

      res = opU(res, vec2(min(dn1, dn2), MAT_NORI));
    }

    // Interior food bounding test
    if (rXZ < 0.93 && p.y > 0.06 && p.y < 0.46) {
      // 1. Noodles
      res = opU(res, vec2(sdNoodles(p), MAT_NOODLE));

      // 2. Seared King Oyster Mushroom Medallions (Front-Left / Left)
      if (p.x < 0.05 && p.z > -0.38 && p.z < 0.42) {
        float dm1 = sdEringiOne(p, vec3(-0.45, 0.238, 0.15), vec2(0.16, -0.14), 0.152, 0.052);
        float dm2 = sdEringiOne(p, vec3(-0.24, 0.252, -0.09), vec2(-0.20, -0.15), 0.142, 0.052);
        float dm3 = sdEringiOne(p, vec3(-0.56, 0.228, -0.13), vec2(0.14, 0.15), 0.132, 0.048);
        res = opU(res, vec2(min(dm1, min(dm2, dm3)), MAT_MUSHROOM));
      }

      // 3. Star-Cut Donko Shiitake Cap (Back-Center)
      if (abs(p.x + 0.03) < 0.26 && abs(p.z + 0.46) < 0.26) {
        vec3 qs = p - vec3(-0.03, 0.225, -0.46);
        qs.zy = rot2(0.24) * qs.zy; // Tilted slightly forward toward viewer
        float rs = length(qs.xz);
        // Plump domed cap with rolled-under margin
        float capH = 0.078 * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.185, rs) * 0.72);
        vec3 qDom = vec3(qs.x, (qs.y - 0.025) * 1.65, qs.z);
        float dCap = length(qDom) - 0.168;
        dCap = max(dCap, -(qs.y + 0.015 + 0.18 * max(0.12 - rs, 0.0)));
        // Hana-donko 4-point star cut across crown
        if (dCap < 0.025 && qs.y > 0.02) {
          vec2 st = rot2(0.785) * qs.xz;
          float cut1 = smoothstep(0.026, 0.0, abs(st.x)) * smoothstep(0.13, 0.04, abs(st.y));
          float cut2 = smoothstep(0.026, 0.0, abs(st.y)) * smoothstep(0.13, 0.04, abs(st.x));
          dCap += max(cut1, cut2) * 0.014;
        }
        res = opU(res, vec2(dCap * 0.65, MAT_SHIITAKE));
      }

      // 4. Baby Bok Choy (Back-Left: celadon stems fanning into crinkled emerald leaves)
      if (p.x < 0.02 && p.z < 0.04) {
        float dBok = 1e5;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
          float fi = float(i);
          float ang = 2.38 + (fi - 1.0) * 0.28;
          vec3 qb = p - vec3(-0.26, 0.215 + fi * 0.012, -0.24);
          qb.xz = rot2(-ang) * qb.xz;
          //qb.x runs outward from 0.0 (stem base) to 0.50 (leaf tip)
          float lx = clamp(qb.x, 0.0, 0.48);
          float archY = 0.14 * sin(lx * 4.4) + 0.08 * lx;
          float width = mix(0.048, 0.125, smoothstep(0.14, 0.42, lx));
          // U-channel stem cupping flattening into ruffled leaf
          float cup = mix(0.38, 0.08, smoothstep(0.18, 0.38, lx)) * qb.z * qb.z / max(width, 0.04);
          float ruffle = smoothstep(0.18, 0.45, lx) * 0.012 * sin(qb.z * 38.0 + lx * 18.0);
          float thick = mix(0.016, 0.007, smoothstep(0.15, 0.38, lx));
          vec3 dLocal = vec3(qb.x - lx, qb.y - archY - cup - ruffle, max(abs(qb.z) - width, 0.0));
          dBok = smin(dBok, length(dLocal) - thick, 0.012);
        }
        res = opU(res, vec2(dBok, MAT_BOKCHOY));
      }

      // 5. Crispy Caramelized Tofu Cutlet Slices (Right Side)
      if (p.x > 0.16 && abs(p.z + 0.06) < 0.42) {
        vec3 qt1 = p - vec3(0.49, 0.242, 0.07);
        qt1.xz = rot2(-0.35) * qt1.xz;
        qt1.xy = rot2(0.22) * qt1.xy;
        float dt1 = sdBox(qt1, vec3(0.165, 0.028, 0.115)) - 0.012;

        vec3 qt2 = p - vec3(0.43, 0.258, -0.17);
        qt2.xz = rot2(-0.55) * qt2.xz;
        qt2.xy = rot2(0.26) * qt2.xy;
        qt2.zy = rot2(-0.14) * qt2.zy;
        float dt2 = sdBox(qt2, vec3(0.160, 0.028, 0.110)) - 0.012;

        float dTofu = min(dt1, dt2);
        if (dTofu < 0.02) {
          dTofu += 0.0025 * (noise3(p * 42.0) - 0.5);
        }
        res = opU(res, vec2(dTofu, MAT_TOFU));
      }

      // 6. Sweet Golden Corn Cluster (Front-Right)
      vec2 cornCenter = vec2(0.33, 0.35);
      float rCorn = length(p.xz - cornCenter);
      if (rCorn < 0.25 && p.y < 0.31) {
        float sp = 0.044;
        vec2 gc = p.xz / sp;
        vec2 id = floor(gc);
        float dCorn = 1e5;
        // 2x2 nearest kernel lookup for seamless cells
        vec2 f = fract(gc) - 0.5;
        vec2 offBase = vec2(f.x < 0.0 ? -1.0 : 0.0, f.y < 0.0 ? -1.0 : 0.0);
        for (int j = 0; j <= 1; j++) {
          for (int i = 0; i <= 1; i++) {
            vec2 cid = id + offBase + vec2(float(i), float(j));
            vec2 rnd = hash22(cid + 31.7);
            vec2 kxz = (cid + 0.5 + (rnd - 0.5) * 0.38) * sp;
            float distC = length(kxz - cornCenter);
            if (distC < 0.195 - 0.025 * rnd.x) {
              float kh = 0.228 + 0.028 * (1.0 - (distC / 0.20) * (distC / 0.20)) + 0.006 * rnd.y;
              vec3 qk = p - vec3(kxz.x, kh, kxz.y);
              qk.xz = rot2(rnd.x * TAU) * qk.xz;
              float dk = sdBox(qk, vec3(0.011, 0.008, 0.008)) - 0.011;
              dCorn = min(dCorn, dk);
            }
          }
        }
        res = opU(res, vec2(dCorn, MAT_CORN));
      }

      // 7. Sliced Green Scallion Rings (Center Garnish Mound + Scattered Broth Floaters)
      float dScal = 1e5;
      // Center mound of freshly sliced negi rings
      vec3 scCenter = vec3(0.03, 0.268, 0.04);
      if (length(p - scCenter) < 0.24) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
          float fi = float(i);
          vec2 h = hash22(vec2(fi * 3.1, fi * 7.7 + 1.3));
          float ang = fi * 2.39996; // Golden angle spiral
          float rad = 0.028 * sqrt(fi + 0.5);
          vec3 cPos = scCenter + vec3(cos(ang) * rad, 0.026 * (1.0 - fi / 10.0) + 0.006 * h.x, sin(ang) * rad);
          vec3 qs = p - cPos;
          qs.xy = rot2((h.x - 0.5) * 1.1) * qs.xy;
          qs.zy = rot2((h.y - 0.5) * 1.1) * qs.zy;
          // Hollow thin green ring
          float rRing = 0.027 + 0.005 * h.x;
          vec2 d2 = abs(vec2(abs(length(qs.xz) - rRing), qs.y)) - vec2(0.0045, 0.007);
          float dr = min(max(d2.x, d2.y), 0.0) + length(max(d2, 0.0)) - 0.002;
          dScal = min(dScal, dr);
        }

        // Fine crimson Ito-Togarashi (chili threads) arching over scallion pile
        float dChili = 1e5;
        for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
          float fk = float(k);
          vec3 qc = p - (scCenter + vec3(0.0, 0.035 + fk * 0.005, 0.0));
          qc.xz = rot2(fk * 1.25 + 0.4) * qc.xz;
          float xCl = clamp(qc.x, -0.075, 0.075);
          float arch = 0.022 * cos(xCl * 19.0) + 0.008 * sin(xCl * 35.0 + fk);
          float zWig = 0.014 * sin(xCl * 24.0 + fk * 2.0);
          float dt = length(qc - vec3(xCl, arch, zWig)) - 0.0032;
          dChili = min(dChili, dt);
        }
        res = opU(res, vec2(dChili, MAT_CHILI));
      }

      // Floating scallion rings bobbing gently on open broth zones
      if (p.y > 0.19 && p.y < 0.26) {
        const vec2 floatPos[6] = vec2[6](
          vec2(-0.14, 0.34),
          vec2(0.14, 0.44),
          vec2(0.24, 0.16),
          vec2(-0.28, 0.38),
          vec2(0.18, -0.24),
          vec2(-0.08, 0.52)
        );
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
          vec2 fp = floatPos[i] + 0.008 * vec2(sin(uTime * 0.8 + float(i)*2.1), cos(uTime * 0.7 + float(i)));
          if (length(p.xz - fp) < 0.055) {
            float bh = 0.221 + 0.002 * sin(fp.x * 14.0 + uTime * 1.5);
            vec3 qs = p - vec3(fp.x, bh + 0.002, fp.y);
            vec2 d2 = abs(vec2(abs(length(qs.xz) - 0.025), qs.y)) - vec2(0.004, 0.005);
            float dr = min(max(d2.x, d2.y), 0.0) + length(max(d2, 0.0)) - 0.002;
            dScal = min(dScal, dr);
          }
        }
      }
      res = opU(res, vec2(dScal, MAT_SCALLION));
    }

    return res;
  }

  // Normal calculation (tetrahedron technique)
  vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p, float eps) {
    const vec2 k = vec2(1.0, -1.0);
    return normalize(
      k.xyy * mapSolid(p + k.xyy * eps).x +
      k.yyx * mapSolid(p + k.yyx * eps).x +
      k.yxy * mapSolid(p + k.yxy * eps).x +
      k.xxx * mapSolid(p + k.xxx * eps).x
    );
  }

  // Soft shadow raymarch
  float calcSoftShadow(vec3 ro, vec3 rd, float tmin, float tmax, float w) {
    float res = 1.0;
    float t = tmin;
    for (int i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
      vec3 p = ro + rd * t;
      if (length(p.xz) > 1.25 || p.y > 0.95) break;
      float h = mapSolid(p).x;
      res = min(res, h / (w * t));
      t += clamp(h, 0.015, 0.12);
      if (res < -1.0 || t > tmax) break;
    }
    res = max(res, -1.0);
    return 0.25 * (1.0 + res) * (1.0 + res) * (2.0 - res);
  }

  float calcAO(vec3 pos, vec3 nor) {
    float occ = 0.0;
    float sca = 1.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      float h = 0.015 + 0.055 * float(i);
      float d = mapSolid(pos + h * nor).x;
      occ += (h - d) * sca;
      sca *= 0.68;
    }
    return clamp(1.0 - 2.6 * occ, 0.08, 1.0);
  }

  // Ray-cylinder intersection for fast acceleration
  vec2 intersectCylinder(vec3 ro, vec3 rd, float rad, float yMin, float yMax) {
    float a = dot(rd.xz, rd.xz);
    float b = dot(ro.xz, rd.xz);
    float c = dot(ro.xz, ro.xz) - rad * rad;
    float disc = b * b - a * c;
    if (disc < 0.0) return vec2(1e5, -1e5);
    float s = sqrt(disc);
    float t0 = (-b - s) / max(a, 1e-6);
    float t1 = (-b + s) / max(a, 1e-6);
    float ty0 = (yMin - ro.y) / rd.y;
    float ty1 = (yMax - ro.y) / rd.y;
    float tNear = max(t0, min(ty0, ty1));
    float tFar  = min(t1, max(ty0, ty1));
    return vec2(max(tNear, 0.0), tFar);
  }

  // Raymarch solid geometry with tight bounding acceleration
  vec2 raymarchSolid(vec3 ro, vec3 rd, out int stepsOut) {
    stepsOut = 0;
    float tPlane = (-0.62 - ro.y) / rd.y;
    vec2 cyl = intersectCylinder(ro, rd, 1.19, -0.625, 0.92);

    // Fast path: Rays missing the bowl cylinder go straight to wood tabletop!
    if (cyl.x > cyl.y || cyl.y < 0.0) {
      if (tPlane > 0.0 && tPlane < 14.0) return vec2(tPlane, MAT_TABLE);
      return vec2(-1.0, 0.0);
    }

    float t = max(0.05, cyl.x);
    float tEnd = min(cyl.y, tPlane > 0.0 ? tPlane + 0.05 : cyl.y);
    for (int i = 0; i < 76; i++) {
      stepsOut = i;
      vec3 p = ro + rd * t;
      vec2 h = mapSolid(p);
      if (abs(h.x) < 0.0014 * (1.0 + 0.25 * t)) {
        return vec2(t, h.y);
      }
      t += h.x * 0.86;
      if (t > tEnd) break;
    }

    if (tPlane > 0.0 && tPlane < 14.0) {
      return vec2(tPlane, MAT_TABLE);
    }
    return vec2(-1.0, 0.0);
  }

  // --- Material & Procedural Culinary Shading ---
  vec3 shadeSolid(vec3 p, vec3 n, vec3 V, float mat, float wetMask) {
    // Studio culinary three-point lighting + dynamic mouse warmth shift
    vec3 keyDir  = normalize(vec3(-0.55 + uMouse.x * 0.16, 0.82, -0.42 + uMouse.y * 0.12));
    vec3 fillDir = normalize(vec3(0.32, 0.88, 0.58));
    vec3 rimDir  = normalize(vec3(0.82, 0.36, -0.52));

    vec3 keyCol  = vec3(1.52, 1.12, 0.72); // Warm izakaya amber lantern
    vec3 fillCol = vec3(0.58, 0.50, 0.42); // Soft overhead warm fill
    vec3 rimCol  = vec3(0.20, 0.28, 0.42); // Cool slate-blue ambient rim

    vec3 albedo = vec3(0.5);
    float rough = 0.4;
    float sss = 0.0;
    vec3 sssCol = vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.15);
    float f0 = 0.04;

    if (mat < 1.5) {
      // MAT_TABLE: Dark charred walnut / yakisugi wood grain
      vec2 wp = p.xz * vec2(2.6, 0.55);
      float grain = fbm2(wp * 4.5 + vec2(0.0, fbm2(wp * 2.0) * 1.8));
      float rings = sin((p.z * 7.5 + grain * 4.2) * 3.14159);
      float ringTex = smoothstep(-0.6, 0.8, rings);
      albedo = mix(vec3(0.022, 0.014, 0.010), vec3(0.058, 0.034, 0.021), ringTex * 0.75 + grain * 0.25);
      // Subtle wood pore bump
      n = normalize(n + vec3(0.0, 0.0, (ringTex - 0.5) * 0.035));
      rough = mix(0.36, 0.62, ringTex);
      // Distance radial vignette on table
      float rTable = length(p.xz);
      albedo *= smoothstep(4.2, 0.5, rTable);

      // Warm ceramic & broth bounce glow onto table around bowl foot
      float bowlProx = exp(-max(rTable - 0.46, 0.0) * 3.2);
      float footAO = smoothstep(0.40, 0.92, rTable) + 0.15 * smoothstep(0.42, 0.0, rTable);
      float sh = calcSoftShadow(p + n * 0.01, keyDir, 0.02, 2.2, 0.18);
      vec3 Hk = normalize(keyDir + V);
      float specK = pow(max(dot(n, Hk), 0.0), mix(90.0, 18.0, rough)) * (1.0 - rough * 0.6);
      vec3 col = albedo * (
        keyCol * max(dot(n, keyDir), 0.0) * sh +
        fillCol * max(dot(n, fillDir), 0.0) * (0.4 + 0.6 * footAO) +
        vec3(0.28, 0.13, 0.04) * bowlProx * 0.45
      );
      col += keyCol * specK * sh * 0.14 * footAO;
      return col * clamp(footAO, 0.08, 1.0);
    }

    if (mat < 2.5) {
      // MAT_BOWL: Hand-thrown Kuro-Raku / Tenmoku Stoneware
      float r = length(p.xz);
      float ang = atan(p.z, p.x);
      // Potter's wheel throwing rings
      float wheel = sin(p.y * 115.0 + 3.0 * noise2(vec2(ang * 4.0, p.y * 12.0)));
      float speck = noise3(p * 65.0);
      // Inner vs outer bowl detection via normal dot radial
      float isInner = smoothstep(-0.2, 0.35, -dot(normalize(vec2(n.x, n.z) + 1e-5), normalize(p.xz + 1e-5)));
      float isRim = smoothstep(0.37, 0.425, p.y);
      float isFoot = smoothstep(-0.52, -0.58, p.y);

      vec3 outerGlaze = mix(vec3(0.032, 0.030, 0.035), vec3(0.055, 0.046, 0.042), speck);
      vec3 innerGlaze = mix(vec3(0.048, 0.038, 0.033), vec3(0.14, 0.082, 0.042), smoothstep(0.20, 0.42, p.y) * 0.65 + speck * 0.25);
      vec3 rimOchre   = vec3(0.24, 0.135, 0.062) * (0.75 + 0.5 * speck);
      vec3 rawClay    = vec3(0.16, 0.095, 0.062);

      albedo = mix(outerGlaze, innerGlaze, isInner);
      albedo = mix(albedo, rimOchre, isRim * 0.72);
      albedo = mix(albedo, rawClay, isFoot);
      n = normalize(n + vec3(0.0, wheel * 0.025 * (1.0 - isFoot), 0.0));
      rough = mix(0.28, 0.16, isInner);
      rough = mix(rough, 0.78, isFoot);
      f0 = 0.05;
    } else if (mat < 3.5) {
      // MAT_NORI: Roasted crisp dark-green seaweed sheet with embossed grid & translucency
      float grid = sin(p.x * 160.0 + p.z * 90.0) * sin(p.y * 160.0);
      float nTex = fbm3(p * 28.0);
      albedo = mix(vec3(0.012, 0.024, 0.013), vec3(0.028, 0.048, 0.022), nTex);
      n = normalize(n + 0.04 * vec3(grid, grid * 0.5, -grid));
      rough = mix(0.52, 0.14, wetMask);
      sss = 0.35;
      sssCol = vec3(0.08, 0.22, 0.05);
    } else if (mat < 4.5) {
      // MAT_NOODLE: Chewy golden alkaline wheat noodles
      float starch = noise3(p * 55.0);
      albedo = mix(vec3(0.76, 0.57, 0.23), vec3(0.88, 0.71, 0.34), starch);
      rough = 0.12;
      sss = 0.68;
      sssCol = vec3(0.95, 0.62, 0.18);
      f0 = 0.048;
    } else if (mat < 5.5) {
      // MAT_MUSHROOM: Seared King Oyster Medallions with caramelized diamond scores
      float topMask = smoothstep(0.35, 0.85, n.y);
      float searNoise = fbm3(p * 18.0);
      // Detect score valleys (slightly lower y or steeper normal)
      float ridge = smoothstep(0.68, 0.96, n.y) * topMask;
      float sear = smoothstep(0.25, 0.78, ridge * (0.55 + 0.65 * searNoise));
      vec3 ivoryFlesh = vec3(0.82, 0.73, 0.56);
      vec3 goldSear   = vec3(0.46, 0.21, 0.055);
      vec3 deepChar   = vec3(0.16, 0.055, 0.018);
      albedo = mix(ivoryFlesh, goldSear, sear);
      albedo = mix(albedo, deepChar, smoothstep(0.75, 0.98, sear * searNoise * 1.4));
      rough = mix(0.24, 0.11, topMask); // Tare butter glaze on top!
      sss = 0.55;
      sssCol = vec3(0.92, 0.58, 0.24);
    } else if (mat < 6.5) {
      // MAT_SHIITAKE: Glazed Donko Shiitake with carved ivory star crown
      vec3 qs = p - vec3(-0.03, 0.225, -0.46);
      qs.zy = rot2(0.24) * qs.zy;
      vec2 st = rot2(0.785) * qs.xz;
      float star = max(
        smoothstep(0.025, 0.005, abs(st.x)) * smoothstep(0.13, 0.04, abs(st.y)),
        smoothstep(0.025, 0.005, abs(st.y)) * smoothstep(0.13, 0.04, abs(st.x))
      ) * smoothstep(0.02, 0.05, qs.y);
      float capTex = fbm3(p * 32.0);
      vec3 umberCap = mix(vec3(0.085, 0.042, 0.022), vec3(0.18, 0.088, 0.042), capTex);
      vec3 starFlesh = vec3(0.80, 0.70, 0.53);
      albedo = mix(umberCap, starFlesh, star);
      rough = mix(0.16, 0.38, star);
      sss = 0.35;
      sssCol = vec3(0.65, 0.32, 0.12);
    } else if (mat < 7.5) {
      // MAT_BOKCHOY: Crisp pale-jade ribbed stem into lush emerald crinkled leaf
      float distStem = length(p.xz - vec2(-0.26, -0.24));
      float leafBlend = smoothstep(0.14, 0.32, distStem);
      float veins = smoothstep(0.3, 0.9, abs(sin((p.x - p.z) * 55.0)));
      vec3 stemJade = vec3(0.62, 0.74, 0.48);
      vec3 leafEmer = mix(vec3(0.045, 0.19, 0.048), vec3(0.12, 0.32, 0.075), veins * 0.5);
      // Light wok char on outer leaf tips
      float charTip = smoothstep(0.38, 0.47, distStem) * smoothstep(0.5, 0.85, fbm3(p * 30.0));
      albedo = mix(stemJade, leafEmer, leafBlend);
      albedo = mix(albedo, vec3(0.06, 0.035, 0.018), charTip * 0.7);
      rough = 0.17;
      sss = 0.62;
      sssCol = mix(vec3(0.55, 0.82, 0.32), vec3(0.18, 0.58, 0.12), leafBlend);
    } else if (mat < 8.5) {
      // MAT_TOFU: Crispy caramelized soy-maple tofu chashu slices
      float pores = fbm3(p * 48.0);
      float edgeChar = smoothstep(0.55, 0.88, pores) * smoothstep(0.25, 0.28, p.y);
      vec3 goldenPuff = vec3(0.62, 0.34, 0.09);
      vec3 soyGlaze   = vec3(0.28, 0.10, 0.03);
      albedo = mix(goldenPuff, soyGlaze, smoothstep(0.3, 0.75, pores));
      albedo = mix(albedo, vec3(0.08, 0.025, 0.01), edgeChar * 0.75);
      // Sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds on tofu!
      vec2 sg = p.xz * 52.0;
      vec2 sid = floor(sg);
      vec2 sh = hash22(sid);
      if (sh.x > 0.76 && n.y > 0.65) {
        vec2 sf = fract(sg) - (0.3 + 0.4 * sh);
        sf = rot2(sh.y * TAU) * sf;
        float seed = length(sf * vec2(1.0, 1.7));
        if (seed < 0.22) {
          albedo = (sh.y > 0.3) ? vec3(0.86, 0.76, 0.54) : vec3(0.05, 0.04, 0.04);
          rough = 0.3;
        }
      }
      rough = 0.14;
      sss = 0.42;
      sssCol = vec3(0.85, 0.42, 0.10);
    } else if (mat < 9.5) {
      // MAT_CORN: Plump sweet golden corn kernels
      float kVar = noise3(p * 35.0);
      albedo = mix(vec3(0.92, 0.62, 0.08), vec3(0.98, 0.76, 0.16), kVar);
      rough = 0.11;
      sss = 0.75;
      sssCol = vec3(1.0, 0.68, 0.12);
      f0 = 0.05;
    } else if (mat < 10.5) {
      // MAT_SCALLION: Crisp emerald & pale-green negi rings + sesame seeds
      float gVar = noise3(p * 45.0);
      albedo = mix(vec3(0.11, 0.44, 0.09), vec3(0.45, 0.74, 0.28), gVar);
      rough = 0.24;
      sss = 0.58;
      sssCol = vec3(0.35, 0.82, 0.20);
    } else {
      // MAT_CHILI: Crimson Ito-Togarashi threads
      albedo = vec3(0.76, 0.08, 0.025);
      rough = 0.32;
      sss = 0.55;
      sssCol = vec3(1.0, 0.18, 0.04);
    }

    // Broth meniscus wetness boosts gloss & deepens color near liquid line
    rough = mix(rough, 0.06, wetMask * 0.85);
    albedo = mix(albedo, albedo * vec3(0.92, 0.82, 0.72), wetMask * 0.35);

    float ao = calcAO(p, n);
    float sh = (mat > 2.5) ? calcSoftShadow(p + n * 0.008, keyDir, 0.015, 1.4, 0.22) : calcSoftShadow(p + n * 0.01, keyDir, 0.02, 1.8, 0.18);

    float ndlKey  = max(dot(n, keyDir), 0.0);
    float ndlFill = max(dot(n, fillDir), 0.0);
    float ndlRim  = max(dot(n, rimDir), 0.0);

    // Subsurface wrap lighting (vital for appetizing food!)
    float wrapKey  = max((dot(n, keyDir) + 0.45) / 1.45, 0.0);
    float backTrans = pow(clamp(dot(V, -keyDir + n * 0.45), 0.0, 1.0), 3.0);

    vec3 diff = albedo * (
      keyCol * mix(ndlKey, wrapKey, sss * 0.55) * (0.25 + 0.75 * sh) +
      fillCol * ndlFill * ao +
      rimCol * ndlRim * ao * 0.85 +
      vec3(0.11, 0.065, 0.035) * ao
    );

    // Warm subsurface glow
    diff += sss * sssCol * keyCol * (backTrans * 0.42 + wrapKey * 0.18) * (0.4 + 0.6 * ao);

    // GGX-like dual-lobe specular highlights (glossy tare/oil coat + base roughness)
    vec3 Hk = normalize(keyDir + V);
    vec3 Hf = normalize(fillDir + V);
    float fresnel = f0 + (1.0 - f0) * pow(1.0 - max(dot(n, V), 0.0), 5.0);
    float specExp = mix(220.0, 14.0, rough * rough);
    float specK = pow(max(dot(n, Hk), 0.0), specExp) * (0.18 + 1.8 * (1.0 - rough));
    float specF = pow(max(dot(n, Hf), 0.0), specExp * 0.65) * (0.12 + 0.9 * (1.0 - rough));

    vec3 spec = (keyCol * specK * (0.35 + 0.65 * sh) + fillCol * specF * ao) * (0.35 + 0.65 * fresnel);
    // Warm environment reflection on slick glazes
    spec += fresnel * vec3(0.26, 0.17, 0.10) * (1.0 - rough) * ao;

    return diff + spec;
  }

  // --- Ray-Broth Surface Intersection inside Bowl ---
  float intersectBroth(vec3 ro, vec3 rd) {
    // Analytic intersection with base broth plane y = 0.222, then 3 secant refinements
    if (abs(rd.y) < 1e-4) return -1.0;
    float t = (0.222 - ro.y) / rd.y;
    if (t < 0.05 || t > 8.0) return -1.0;
    vec3 p = ro + rd * t;
    if (length(p.xz) > 0.965) return -1.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      p = ro + rd * t;
      float h = evalBrothState(p.xz).x;
      t += (h - p.y) / rd.y;
    }
    p = ro + rd * t;
    if (length(p.xz) > 0.965) return -1.0;
    return t;
  }

  // --- Volumetric Curling Steam & Rising Warm Micro-Droplets ---
  vec4 traceSteam(vec3 ro, vec3 rd, float tMax, vec2 fragCoord) {
    // Bounding cylinder of rising steam column above the hot bowl
    vec2 cyl = intersectCylinder(ro, rd, 0.96, 0.21, 2.08);
    if (cyl.x > cyl.y || cyl.y < 0.0 || cyl.x > tMax) return vec4(0.0);

    float t0 = max(cyl.x, 0.05);
    float t1 = min(cyl.y, tMax);
    if (t1 <= t0) return vec4(0.0);

    const int STEPS = 18;
    float dt = (t1 - t0) / float(STEPS);
    float jitter = hash12(fragCoord + fract(uTime * 7.13) * 100.0);
    float t = t0 + dt * jitter;

    vec3 keyDir = normalize(vec3(-0.55 + uMouse.x * 0.16, 0.82, -0.42 + uMouse.y * 0.12));
    float phase = 0.45 + 0.55 * pow(max(dot(rd, -keyDir), 0.0), 2.5);

    vec3 accCol = vec3(0.0);
    float accAlpha = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < STEPS; i++) {
      vec3 p = ro + rd * t;
      float hNorm = clamp((p.y - 0.21) / 1.85, 0.0, 1.0);

      // Natural convection swirl + interactive mouse draft deflection!
      vec3 q = p;
      float rise = uTime * 0.34;
      float swirlAng = hNorm * 1.8 - uTime * 0.22;
      q.xz = rot2(swirlAng * 0.35) * q.xz;

      // Mouse breeze gently parts and curls the steam plume
      if (uMouseWorld.z > 0.5) {
        vec2 mDiff = p.xz - uMouseWorld.xy * (1.0 + hNorm * 0.4);
        float mDist2 = dot(mDiff, mDiff) + 0.09;
        float push = (0.14 + 0.45 * length(uMouseVel)) * smoothstep(0.0, 0.35, hNorm) / mDist2;
        q.xz -= (mDiff * 0.55 + uMouseVel * 0.85) * min(push, 0.55);
      }

      // Expand gently then taper into delicate tendrils
      float plumeRad = mix(0.76, 0.56, hNorm) + 0.14 * sin(hNorm * 5.0 - uTime * 0.6);
      float radialMask = smoothstep(plumeRad, plumeRad * 0.18, length(q.xz));
      float vertMask = smoothstep(0.0, 0.13, hNorm) * pow(1.0 - hNorm, 1.35);

      if (radialMask * vertMask > 0.01) {
        vec3 st = vec3(q.x * 2.35, q.y * 1.55 - rise * 2.1, q.z * 2.35);
        // Domain warp for silky curling ramen steam tendrils
        vec3 warp = vec3(
          noise3(st * 1.15 + vec3(0.0, -rise, 4.2)) - 0.5,
          noise3(st * 1.15 + vec3(7.1, -rise, 1.3)) - 0.5,
          noise3(st * 1.15 + vec3(2.9, -rise, 8.7)) - 0.5
        );
        float n1 = fbm3(st + warp * 1.35);
        // Silky ridge wisps
        float wisp1 = 1.0 - abs(n1 * 2.0 - 1.0);
        wisp1 = pow(clamp(wisp1, 0.0, 1.0), 2.4);
        float wisp2 = smoothstep(0.46, 0.82, n1);
        float dens = (wisp1 * 0.65 + wisp2 * 0.45) * radialMask * vertMask;
        dens = smoothstep(0.11, 0.62, dens) * 0.24;

        if (dens > 0.001) {
          // Warm amber glow near hot broth transitioning to cool translucent silver-amber high up
          vec3 baseGlow = mix(vec3(1.05, 0.72, 0.44), vec3(0.62, 0.68, 0.78), smoothstep(0.05, 0.85, hNorm));
          vec3 rimLight = vec3(1.35, 0.94, 0.58) * phase * (0.45 + 0.55 * smoothstep(-0.5, 0.6, -p.x + p.y * 0.4));
          vec3 sampleCol = (baseGlow * 0.55 + rimLight * 0.65);

          float stepA = 1.0 - exp(-dens * dt * 2.8);
          accCol += (1.0 - accAlpha) * sampleCol * stepA;
          accAlpha += (1.0 - accAlpha) * stepA;
          if (accAlpha > 0.92) break;
        }
      }
      t += dt;
    }
    return vec4(accCol, accAlpha);
  }

  void main() {
    vec2 uv = (gl_FragCoord.xy - 0.5 * uRes) / min(uRes.x, uRes.y);

    // Subtle organic camera sway + interactive cursor parallax
    float idleT = uTime;
    float camAzim = uMouse.x * 0.14 + 0.018 * sin(idleT * 0.35) * (1.0 - uReduced);
    float camElev = 0.62 + uMouse.y * 0.07 + 0.010 * cos(idleT * 0.28) * (1.0 - uReduced);

    // Responsive camera distance so mobile portrait & desktop ultrawide both frame the bowl heroically
    float aspect = uRes.x / max(uRes.y, 1.0);
    float portraitZoom = mix(1.28, 1.0, clamp((aspect - 0.52) / 0.55, 0.0, 1.0));
    float camDist = 3.22 * portraitZoom;

    vec3 target = vec3(0.0, 0.15 + (portraitZoom - 1.0) * 0.12, -0.04);
    vec3 ro = target + camDist * vec3(
      sin(camAzim) * cos(camElev),
      sin(camElev),
      cos(camAzim) * cos(camElev)
    );

    vec3 fwd = normalize(target - ro);
    vec3 right = normalize(cross(fwd, vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)));
    vec3 up = cross(right, fwd);
    float focal = 1.92;
    vec3 rd = normalize(fwd * focal + right * uv.x + up * uv.y);

    // Atmospheric smoky izakaya backdrop (warm subtle radial lantern bokeh behind bowl)
    float bgGlow = exp(-dot(uv - vec2(-0.08, 0.12), uv - vec2(-0.08, 0.12)) * 2.8);
    vec3 col = mix(vec3(0.010, 0.007, 0.006), vec3(0.052, 0.028, 0.014), bgGlow);

    // Raymarch solid geometry & broth surface
    int steps = 0;
    vec2 hitSolid = raymarchSolid(ro, rd, steps);
    float tSolid = hitSolid.x;
    float matSolid = hitSolid.y;

    float tBroth = intersectBroth(ro, rd);
    float tFirst = (tSolid > 0.0) ? tSolid : 1e5;

    if (tBroth > 0.0 && tBroth < tFirst) {
      // --- Ray Hits Creamy Vegan Broth + Chili Oil Surface First! ---
      tFirst = tBroth;
      vec3 pB = ro + rd * tBroth;
      vec3 bState = evalBrothState(pB.xz);
      float oilMask = bState.y;
      float mayuMask = bState.z;

      // Broth + oil meniscus normal via central differences
      float eB = 0.004;
      float hx = evalBrothState(pB.xz + vec2(eB, 0.0)).x - evalBrothState(pB.xz - vec2(eB, 0.0)).x;
      float hz = evalBrothState(pB.xz + vec2(0.0, eB)).x - evalBrothState(pB.xz - vec2(0.0, eB)).x;
      vec3 nBroth = normalize(vec3(-hx, 2.0 * eB, -hz));

      vec3 V = -rd;

      // Underwater refraction trace to see noodles & toppings dipping beneath broth
      vec3 rdSub = refract(rd, nBroth, 0.76);
      float tSub = max(tSolid - tBroth, 0.005);
      // 3 short refinement steps along refracted ray
      float tRef = 0.015;
      float subMat = matSolid;
      for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
        vec2 hs = mapSolid(pB + rdSub * tRef);
        subMat = hs.y;
        if (abs(hs.x) < 0.002) break;
        tRef += clamp(hs.x, 0.005, 0.08);
      }
      vec3 pSub = pB + rdSub * tRef;
      vec3 nSub = calcNormal(pSub, 0.0025);
      vec3 subCol = shadeSolid(pSub, nSub, -rdSub, subMat, 1.0);

      // Fiery chili oil refracts warm orange-ruby caustics onto shallow submerged noodles!
      subCol *= mix(vec3(1.0), vec3(1.35, 0.42, 0.08), oilMask * 0.75);

      // Creamy roasted-sesame miso broth turbidity + Beer-Lambert scattering
      float depth = clamp(tRef, 0.0, 0.35);
      vec3 keyDir = normalize(vec3(-0.55 + uMouse.x * 0.16, 0.82, -0.42 + uMouse.y * 0.12));
      vec3 fillDir = normalize(vec3(0.32, 0.88, 0.58));
      float shBroth = calcSoftShadow(pB + vec3(0.0, 0.012, 0.0), keyDir, 0.015, 1.3, 0.24);

      // Rich oat-sesame white miso broth base color with edge golden scatter
      vec3 creamyBroth = mix(
        vec3(0.58, 0.32, 0.10),
        vec3(0.76, 0.48, 0.19),
        exp(-depth * 18.0) * 0.5 + 0.5 * shBroth
      );
      // Dark roasted black garlic swirl
      creamyBroth = mix(creamyBroth, vec3(0.045, 0.025, 0.015), mayuMask * 0.82);

      // Blend submerged solid into turbid creamy broth
      float brothOpacity = 1.0 - exp(-depth * 32.0);
      vec3 bodyCol = mix(subCol, creamyBroth * (0.45 + 0.75 * shBroth), brothOpacity);

      // Translucent ruby Rayu chili oil layer on top of broth
      vec3 chiliTint = mix(vec3(0.88, 0.14, 0.018), vec3(1.15, 0.34, 0.03), exp(-depth * 24.0));
      bodyCol = mix(bodyCol, bodyCol * chiliTint * 1.45 + vec3(0.28, 0.035, 0.004) * (0.4 + 0.6 * shBroth), oilMask * 0.88);

      // Micro-bubbles clinging near bowl rim & toppings
      float rimBub = smoothstep(0.85, 0.955, length(pB.xz)) * smoothstep(0.68, 0.86, noise2(pB.xz * 85.0));
      bodyCol = mix(bodyCol, vec3(0.92, 0.76, 0.52), rimBub * 0.45);

      // Crisp liquid Fresnel reflections & specular highlights
      float f0 = mix(0.028, 0.052, oilMask);
      float fres = f0 + (1.0 - f0) * pow(1.0 - max(dot(nBroth, V), 0.0), 5.0);
      vec3 Hk = normalize(keyDir + V);
      vec3 Hf = normalize(fillDir + V);
      float specK = pow(max(dot(nBroth, Hk), 0.0), mix(280.0, 420.0, oilMask));
      float specF = pow(max(dot(nBroth, Hf), 0.0), 140.0);

      vec3 reflEnv = mix(vec3(0.06, 0.04, 0.03), vec3(0.45, 0.28, 0.14), smoothstep(-0.1, 0.6, reflect(rd, nBroth).y));
      col = mix(bodyCol, reflEnv, fres * 0.65)
          + vec3(1.65, 1.22, 0.78) * specK * (0.35 + 0.65 * shBroth) * 1.45
          + vec3(0.65, 0.55, 0.45) * specF * 0.55;

    } else if (tSolid > 0.0) {
      // --- Ray Hits Emergent Food, Ceramic Bowl, Nori, or Wood Table ---
      vec3 p = ro + rd * tSolid;
      float eps = (matSolid < 1.5) ? 0.003 : 0.0016;
      vec3 n = (matSolid < 1.5) ? vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0) : calcNormal(p, eps);

      // Wet broth meniscus collar where food/inner bowl emerges from liquid!
      float wetMask = 0.0;
      if (matSolid > 1.5 && length(p.xz) < 0.965) {
        float bh = evalBrothState(p.xz).x;
        wetMask = smoothstep(0.032, -0.004, p.y - bh);
      }

      col = shadeSolid(p, n, -rd, matSolid, wetMask);
    }

    // --- Volumetric Rising Steam Composite ---
    vec4 steam = traceSteam(ro, rd, tFirst, gl_FragCoord.xy);
    col = col * (1.0 - steam.a * 0.55) + steam.rgb;

    // Tiny rising warm vapor micro-motes catching key light
    for (int m = 0; m < 7; m++) {
      float fm = float(m);
      float cycle = fract(uTime * (0.09 + 0.015 * fm) + fm * 0.17);
      vec3 motePos = vec3(
        0.42 * sin(fm * 4.1 + cycle * 4.5),
        0.28 + cycle * 1.35,
        0.42 * cos(fm * 2.7 + cycle * 3.8)
      );
      if (uMouseWorld.z > 0.5) {
        motePos.xz += uMouseVel * 0.25 * cycle;
      }
      vec3 toMote = motePos - ro;
      float proj = dot(toMote, rd);
      if (proj > 0.0 && proj < tFirst) {
        float distRay = length(toMote - rd * proj);
        float fade = sin(cycle * PI) * (1.0 - uReduced * 0.6);
        float glow = exp(-distRay * distRay * 4200.0) * fade * 0.16;
        col += vec3(1.15, 0.78, 0.42) * glow;
      }
    }

    fragColor = vec4(max(col, vec3(0.0)), 1.0);
  }`;

  // Pass 2: Soft Atmospheric Bloom + ACES Filmic Tone Mapping + Cinema Grain
  const POST_FRAG_SRC = `#version 300 es
  precision highp float;

  in vec2 vUv;
  out vec4 fragColor;

  uniform sampler2D uScene;
  uniform vec2 uRes;
  uniform float uTime;

  vec3 acesFilm(vec3 x) {
    float a = 2.51;
    float b = 0.03;
    float c = 2.43;
    float d = 0.59;
    float e = 0.14;
    return clamp((x * (a * x + b)) / (x * (c * x + d) + e), 0.0, 1.0);
  }

  float hash12(vec2 p) {
    vec3 p3 = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * 0.1031);
    p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);
    return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);
  }

  void main() {
    vec2 px = 1.0 / uRes;
    vec3 hdr = texture(uScene, vUv).rgb;

    // Multi-radius warm halation / soft bloom around highlights & steam
    vec3 bloom = vec3(0.0);
    float totalW = 0.0;
    const vec2 dirs[8] = vec2[8](
      vec2(1.0, 0.0), vec2(-1.0, 0.0), vec2(0.0, 1.0), vec2(0.0, -1.0),
      vec2(0.707, 0.707), vec2(-0.707, 0.707), vec2(0.707, -0.707), vec2(-0.707, -0.707)
    );
    for (int r = 1; r <= 3; r++) {
      float rad = float(r * r) * 2.6;
      float w = 1.0 / float(r);
      for (int d = 0; d < 8; d++) {
        vec3 s = texture(uScene, clamp(vUv + dirs[d] * px * rad, 0.001, 0.999)).rgb;
        float lum = dot(s, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
        vec3 hi = s * smoothstep(0.42, 1.35, lum);
        bloom += hi * w;
        totalW += w;
      }
    }
    bloom /= totalW;

    // Warm golden halation tint
    hdr += bloom * vec3(0.32, 0.24, 0.17);

    // Subtle studio vignette keeping edges pure dark obsidian
    vec2 centered = vUv - 0.5;
    float vig = 1.0 - dot(centered, centered) * 0.72;
    hdr *= clamp(vig, 0.22, 1.0);

    // Exposure & ACES filmic curve
    vec3 ldr = acesFilm(hdr * 1.18);
    ldr = pow(ldr, vec3(1.0 / 2.2));

    // Subtle organic dithering grain to prevent dark gradient banding
    float grain = (hash12(gl_FragCoord.xy + fract(uTime) * 97.0) - 0.5) * (1.8 / 255.0);
    ldr = clamp(ldr + grain, 0.0, 1.0);

    fragColor = vec4(ldr, 1.0);
  }`;

  function compileShader(type, src) {
    const sh = gl.createShader(type);
    gl.shaderSource(sh, src);
    gl.compileShader(sh);
    if (!gl.getShaderParameter(sh, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
      console.error('Shader error:', gl.getShaderInfoLog(sh));
      gl.deleteShader(sh);
      return null;
    }
    return sh;
  }

  function createProgram(vsSrc, fsSrc) {
    const vs = compileShader(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vsSrc);
    const fs = compileShader(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fsSrc);
    if (!vs || !fs) return null;
    const prog = gl.createProgram();
    gl.attachShader(prog, vs);
    gl.attachShader(prog, fs);
    gl.linkProgram(prog);
    if (!gl.getProgramParameter(prog, gl.LINK_STATUS)) {
      console.error('Link error:', gl.getProgramInfoLog(prog));
      return null;
    }
    return prog;
  }

  const sceneProg = createProgram(VERT_SRC, SCENE_FRAG_SRC);
  const postProg = createProgram(VERT_SRC, POST_FRAG_SRC);
  if (!sceneProg || !postProg) {
    renderCanvas2DFallback(canvas, reducedMotion);
    return;
  }

  const vao = gl.createVertexArray();
  gl.bindVertexArray(vao);

  const sceneUni = {
    uRes: gl.getUniformLocation(sceneProg, 'uRes'),
    uTime: gl.getUniformLocation(sceneProg, 'uTime'),
    uMouse: gl.getUniformLocation(sceneProg, 'uMouse'),
    uMouseVel: gl.getUniformLocation(sceneProg, 'uMouseVel'),
    uMouseWorld: gl.getUniformLocation(sceneProg, 'uMouseWorld'),
    uRipple: gl.getUniformLocation(sceneProg, 'uRipple'),
    uReduced: gl.getUniformLocation(sceneProg, 'uReduced')
  };

  const postUni = {
    uScene: gl.getUniformLocation(postProg, 'uScene'),
    uRes: gl.getUniformLocation(postProg, 'uRes'),
    uTime: gl.getUniformLocation(postProg, 'uTime')
  };

  // Offscreen HDR/LDR framebuffer for post-processing
  let fbo = null;
  let fboTex = null;
  let renderW = 0;
  let renderH = 0;
  let displayW = 0;
  let displayH = 0;

  // Dynamic resolution scaling for silky-smooth framerate on any screen
  let resScale = 0.85;

  function setupFBO(w, h) {
    if (fbo) gl.deleteFramebuffer(fbo);
    if (fboTex) gl.deleteTexture(fboTex);

    fboTex = gl.createTexture();
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, fboTex);
    const internalFormat = extFloat ? gl.RGBA16F : gl.RGBA8;
    const type = extFloat ? gl.HALF_FLOAT : gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE;
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, internalFormat, w, h, 0, gl.RGBA, type, null);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);

    fbo = gl.createFramebuffer();
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, fbo);
    gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, fboTex, 0);

    if (gl.checkFramebufferStatus(gl.FRAMEBUFFER) !== gl.FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE) {
      gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA8, w, h, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, null);
    }
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
  }

  function resize() {
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2.0);
    displayW = Math.max(1, Math.floor(window.innerWidth * dpr));
    displayH = Math.max(1, Math.floor(window.innerHeight * dpr));
    canvas.width = displayW;
    canvas.height = displayH;

    renderW = Math.max(1, Math.floor(displayW * resScale));
    renderH = Math.max(1, Math.floor(displayH * resScale));
    setupFBO(renderW, renderH);
    needsStaticRender = true;
  }

  // Interactive pointer state
  const pointer = {
    targetX: 0,
    targetY: 0,
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    rawX: 0.5,
    rawY: 0.5,
    active: false
  };

  const ripple = {
    x: 0,
    z: 0,
    startTime: -10,
    strength: 0
  };

  let simTime = 4.2; // Start at an atmospheric hero phase
  let needsStaticRender = true;

  // Project screen pointer onto the broth plane y = 0.22 in 3D world space
  function computePointerBrothHit() {
    if (!pointer.active) return [0, 0, 0];
    const aspect = renderW / Math.max(renderH, 1);
    const uvX = ((pointer.rawX - 0.5) * renderW) / Math.min(renderW, renderH);
    const uvY = ((0.5 - pointer.rawY) * renderH) / Math.min(renderW, renderH);

    const camAzim = pointer.x * 0.14 + (reducedMotion ? 0 : 0.018 * Math.sin(simTime * 0.35));
    const camElev = 0.62 + pointer.y * 0.07 + (reducedMotion ? 0 : 0.010 * Math.cos(simTime * 0.28));
    const portraitZoom = 1.28 + (1.0 - 1.28) * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (aspect - 0.52) / 0.55));
    const camDist = 3.22 * portraitZoom;

    const tx = 0.0;
    const ty = 0.15 + (portraitZoom - 1.0) * 0.12;
    const tz = -0.04;

    const roX = tx + camDist * Math.sin(camAzim) * Math.cos(camElev);
    const roY = ty + camDist * Math.sin(camElev);
    const roZ = tz + camDist * Math.cos(camAzim) * Math.cos(camElev);

    let fx = tx - roX, fy = ty - roY, fz = tz - roZ;
    const fl = Math.hypot(fx, fy, fz);
    fx /= fl; fy /= fl; fz /= fl;
